errors.text_span: 刻度范围从0至180,000，单位为人，刻度间隔为20,000
errors.evidence: Description states the left y-axis range as 0–180,000 with intervals of 20,000, but the figure shows 0–1,800,000 with intervals of 200,000.

errors.text_span: 峰值出现在7月15日前后，接近160,000人
errors.evidence: Description states the peak near July 15 is 160,000 people, but the figure shows peaks closer to 1,600,000.
While the purpose is somewhat mentioned, the description lacks explicit mention of comparing global daily new confirmed COVID cases with related news reports.
